purpose: test whether explicit historical home/away performance adds OOS information to goals and BTTS
evidence: reuse frozen V32.2 evidence_v2 bytes only; no new provider, market or LLM calls

venue_conditioning.target_home_team: prior non-neutral matches where that team was home
venue_conditioning.target_away_team: prior non-neutral matches where that team was away
venue_conditioning.neutral_matches: excluded from venue-conditioned profile; retained in all-venue profile

feature_semantics.btts_rate: indicator own regulation goals > 0 and opponent regulation goals > 0

arms.goals_control: DEEP_POISSON from the identical V32.2 feature basis and fold policy
arms.goals_xg_candidate: VENUE_DEEP_POISSON_XG on support-matched xG cohort only
arms.btts_control: BTTS derived coherently from DEEP_POISSON joint goal distribution
arms.btts_candidate: BTTS derived coherently from VENUE_DEEP_POISSON joint goal distribution
arms.direct_btts_secondary: DIRECT_VENUE_LOGISTIC using the same venue-conditioned pre-match evidence

chronology: reuse V32.2 five expanding folds with non-overlapping tests and 28h purge

calibration.count: side multiplicative calibration on calibration segment only
calibration.direct_btts: regularized Platt calibration on calibration segment only

evaluation.uncertainty: paired ISO-week block bootstrap; fixture rows grouped; 2000 resamples; seed 3230

support_rules: venue-specific feature requires minimum three eligible historical venue matches
venue values shrink to all-venue team profile
xG never backfills from another field and is evaluated only on support-matched fixtures
current target-match statistics never enter its own pre-match feature vector
all inputs must precede the target feature horizon
market_layer: excluded from fitting and model selection
promotion: none; existing outcomes are development data; prospective frozen shadow validation required
